expect.summary: Auto-renewal is said but the only reply is uh-huh. Item marked unclear, first charge held.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Thanks for calling GoGoGrandparent, this is Dana. This call is recorded. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Harold Kim. I want to sign up.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Glad to help, Harold. GoGo lets you book rides and order groceries and meals by phone, with no smartphone app. You call or text us, we book the ride with a driver service, and we keep an eye on the trip.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: The Value plan is $34.00 per month, billed monthly.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: And this renews automatically each month unless you cancel.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: You can cancel any time with no fee. To cancel, call us, email us, or cancel online in your account settings.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Our toll-free number is 1-855-464-6872 and our email is support@gogograndparent.com, for cancelling or any questions.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Our Terms include an arbitration agreement and a class action waiver, so disputes go to individual arbitration instead of court.

segments.speaker: operator
segments.text: Harold, do you authorize GoGoGrandparent to charge your Visa ending in 3391 $34.00 today and every month until you cancel?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, go ahead and charge it.
